game.blurb: Stealth assassination game set in sandbox missions around the world, from IO Interactive, released 2021-01-20. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam app list has no app named "Hitman 3"; the store app is 1659040, now named "HITMAN World of Assassination", and its achievement schema still calls the game "HITMAN 3". Its 83 achievements cover the Hitman 3 locations plus many older locations (Paris, Sapienza, New York, Miami and others), so the extra chapters reflect what the World of Assassination app contains. StrategyWiki has no page under "Hitman 3" or "Hitman III"; "HITMAN 3" exists as a stub (completion stage 0) whose only subpage is an 80-character Table of Contents, so nothing was used. hitman.fandom.com answers the API under "Hitman 3", with about 78 linked pages, mostly series titles, places and characters; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 12 of 83 Steam achievements are hidden; they come in pairs right after each Hitman 3 location's "Reveal all undiscovered areas" achievement, so each pair was put with that location by position. That is a guess and needs checking. RAWG lists "HITMAN 3 Access Pass: HITMAN 2 Gold" as a separate entry.
